hero.eyebrow: A native macOS menu bar utility
hero.title: Small tools.
hero.description: Maclet brings music, application audio, daily tasks, timers and clipboard history into one lightweight place — without pulling you out of your work.

features.title: Eight utilities. One native rhythm.
features.description: Each module stays compact, focused and independently configurable.

playing.title: Now Playing
playing.description: See the current track and control Spotify, Apple Music or Chrome, and switch the audio output without switching windows.

mixer.title: Audio Mixer
mixer.description: Choose an output and manage supported application volume from a compact mixer.

tasks.title: Daily Tasks
tasks.description: Capture priorities, add tags and carry unfinished work into the next day.

timer.title: Timer
timer.description: Start, pause and preserve focused sessions with a local activity history.

clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.description: Search recent text, organize it with tags and recall it with a global shortcut.

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.description: Start a 5, 10, 20 or 60 minute preset or pick a clock time, then finish with a notification or a looping alarm.

screenshot.title: Screenshot
screenshot.description: Select a region with a global shortcut, annotate with pen, shapes and arrows, then copy or save as PNG.

hub.title: Menu Bar Hub
hub.description: Merge selected tools under one icon, or keep them as separate items you can reorder and customize.

native.title: Private, local and unmistakably Mac.
native.description: Maclet uses native Apple frameworks and stores utility data locally. There is no account, remote backend or third-party package in the current implementation.

points.local: Clipboard, task and timer data stays on the Mac
points.native: SwiftUI, AppKit, Core Audio and system materials
points.modular: Menu bar modules can be enabled and reordered
points.fast: Compact actions designed for one-click access
points.permissions: Permissions are requested only for the feature that needs them, and managed on one page
points.login: Launch at login, running quietly without a Dock icon

cta.title: Less window switching. More flow.
cta.description: Maclet is currently in active development while its utilities and release path are being refined.

scene.mixerHint: Muted apps move to the end of the list
scene.hubHint: Toggle, reorder and group your tools
